title: better-auth 1.4.0 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an improper authentication vulnerability…
description: better-auth versions 1.4.0 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 have an improper authentication vulnerability. This flaw allows attackers to reuse email-change links issued for their own accounts to hijack victim accounts by changing the victim's email to one controlled by the attacker.
